mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cage_shelf_grid_cache ( shelve_id VARCHAR(32) PRIMARY KEY, grid_json LONGTEXT, shelf_meta_json TEXT, total_cells INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, filled_cells INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, type1_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, type2_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, type3_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, type4_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

ALTER TABLE cage_shelf_grid_cache ADD COLUMN type1_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, ADD COLUMN type2_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, ADD COLUMN type3_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, ADD COLUMN type4_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
mapper.select: SELECT shelve_id AS shelveId, grid_json AS gridJson, shelf_meta_json AS shelfMetaJson, total_cells AS totalCells, filled_cells AS filledCells, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM cage_shelf_grid_cache WHERE shelve_id = #{shelveId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cage_shelf_grid_cache (shelve_id, grid_json, shelf_meta_json, total_cells, filled_cells, type1_count, type2_count, type3_count, type4_count, updated_at) VALUES (#{shelveId}, #{gridJson}, #{shelfMetaJson}, #{totalCells}, #{filledCells}, #{type1Count}, #{type2Count}, #{type3Count}, #{type4Count}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE grid_json = VALUES(grid_json), shelf_meta_json = VALUES(shelf_meta_json), total_cells = VALUES(total_cells), filled_cells = VALUES(filled_cells), type1_count = VALUES(type1_count), type2_count = VALUES(type2_count), type3_count = VALUES(type3_count), type4_count = VALUES(type4_count), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT shelve_id AS shelveId, grid_json AS gridJson FROM cage_shelf_grid_cache
